headline: Brazilian Driver Rafael Câmara to Make F1 Home Debut With Haas
summary: Formula 2 leader and Ferrari Driver Academy member Rafael Câmara, 21, was announced to make his Formula 1 debut with Haas at his home grand prix.
why: Driver announcements impact team sponsorships, brand visibility, and motorsport equity values.

impacts.why: The team signed a new driver for a debut.
